description: ODC (context: workflow). A CrossDevice app refuses any workflow ('Process objects can't be children of App objects'): an ODC workflow is a module of its own, of type BusinessProcess. On the blank module of that type (create-blank --kind BusinessProcess) the job assembles a valid workflow with the ODC nodes. Three things that are only seen here: (1) the module has ONE workflow and it takes the module's name (the create asks for CovWFlow and CovBlankWorkflow is born); (2) the scheduled Start is only valid with TriggerMode Schedule, Frequency and the cron in the ScheduleConfiguration, written by ISchedule.FromCronExpression (set CronExpression); (3) the module cannot have service actions of its own ('Server Action can't be created in BusinessProcess runtime kind'), so the automatic activity triggers the one from the producer app (tests/fixtures/odc/blank-mobile-producer.oml, output of producer-service-event.json). In a decision the LAST outcome created is the Otherwise; the others carry a Value. The parallel finds the join by the paths that end in it. The nodes that wait for an event (human activity, conditional start, event Start) are in the job tests/jobs-coverage/f2-ctx/workflow-event-nodes.json: an event referenced without a handler warns UnusedReferenceGlobalEvent, an ODC-only id that expectedMessages does not accept yet (finding odc-expected-message-catalog).

ops._why: the name is the module's, not the requested one
without this: Workflows_ScheduleNotSet (or ScheduleHoursNotSet/MinutesNotSet with Frequency Daily)
a ultima outcome e o Otherwise
JoinNode = CovWMerge, found by the paths

since ODC Studio 1.7.27 the destination of a go to cannot be a join, start, end, terminate or another go to, and inside a parallel it has to stay on the same path: the go to goes back to the automatic activity (try again)
